import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def mergeSort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def mergeSort_insert (a : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [a]
  | b :: bs =>
      if a ≤ b then
        a :: b :: bs
      else
        b :: mergeSort_insert a bs

def mergeSort_aux : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | a :: as => mergeSort_insert a (mergeSort_aux as)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def mergeSort (v : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  mergeSort_aux v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def mergeSort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
   List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem mergeSort_mem_insert (a y : Int) :
    ∀ l : List Int, y ∈ mergeSort_insert a l ↔ y = a ∨ y ∈ l
  | [] => by
      simp [mergeSort_insert]
  | b :: bs => by
      by_cases h : a ≤ b
      · simp [mergeSort_insert, h]
      · simp [mergeSort_insert, h, mergeSort_mem_insert a y bs,
          or_assoc, or_left_comm, or_comm]

theorem mergeSort_insert_pairwise (a : Int) :
    ∀ l : List Int,
      List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) l →
        List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) (mergeSort_insert a l)
  | [], _ => by
      simp [mergeSort_insert]
  | b :: bs, hsorted => by
      by_cases h : a ≤ b
      · cases hsorted with
        | cons hrel htail =>
            have hall : ∀ y ∈ b :: bs, a ≤ y := by
              intro y hy
              simp at hy
              rcases hy with rfl | hybs
              · exact h
              · exact le_trans h (hrel y hybs)
            have hs :
                List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) (a :: b :: bs) :=
              List.Pairwise.cons hall (List.Pairwise.cons hrel htail)
            simpa [mergeSort_insert, h] using hs
      · cases hsorted with
        | cons hrel htail =>
            have hb_a : b ≤ a := by omega
            have hall : ∀ y ∈ mergeSort_insert a bs, b ≤ y := by
              intro y hy
              have hy' := (mergeSort_mem_insert a y bs).mp hy
              rcases hy' with rfl | hybs
              · exact hb_a
              · exact hrel y hybs
            have htail' :
                List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) (mergeSort_insert a bs) :=
              mergeSort_insert_pairwise a bs htail
            have hs :
                List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) (b :: mergeSort_insert a bs) :=
              List.Pairwise.cons hall htail'
            simpa [mergeSort_insert, h] using hs

theorem mergeSort_aux_pairwise :
    ∀ l : List Int, List.Pairwise (fun x y : Int => x ≤ y) (mergeSort_aux l)
  | [] => by
      simp [mergeSort_aux]
  | a :: as => by
      simpa [mergeSort_aux] using
        mergeSort_insert_pairwise a (mergeSort_aux as) (mergeSort_aux_pairwise as)

theorem mergeSort_insert_perm (a : Int) :
    ∀ l : List Int, (mergeSort_insert a l).Perm (a :: l)
  | [] => by
      simp [mergeSort_insert]
  | b :: bs => by
      by_cases h : a ≤ b
      · simp [mergeSort_insert, h]
      · have ih : (mergeSort_insert a bs).Perm (a :: bs) :=
          mergeSort_insert_perm a bs
        have hperm :
            (b :: mergeSort_insert a bs).Perm (a :: b :: bs) :=
          (List.Perm.cons b ih).trans ((List.Perm.swap b a bs).symm)
        simpa [mergeSort_insert, h] using hperm

theorem mergeSort_aux_perm :
    ∀ l : List Int, (mergeSort_aux l).Perm l
  | [] => by
      simp [mergeSort_aux]
  | a :: as => by
      have h₁ : (mergeSort_insert a (mergeSort_aux as)).Perm (a :: mergeSort_aux as) :=
        mergeSort_insert_perm a (mergeSort_aux as)
      have h₂ : (a :: mergeSort_aux as).Perm (a :: as) :=
        List.Perm.cons a (mergeSort_aux_perm as)
      simpa [mergeSort_aux] using h₁.trans h₂
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem mergeSort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) :
    mergeSort_postcond v (mergeSort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · simpa [mergeSort, List.Sorted] using mergeSort_aux_pairwise v
  · simpa [mergeSort] using mergeSort_aux_perm v
  -- !benchmark @end proof
